rationale: C10 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s government-wide administrative scheme. Most notably, both define the covered federal “agency” through a closely parallel enumeration of departments, commissions, boards, authorities, other establishments, and wholly owned instrumentalities or corporations. Both then impose duties across those agencies and authorize implementing regulations that must remain consistent with the order. C23 has a related government-wide employee-compensation structure with definitions, agency coverage, eligibility rules, payment procedures, and delegated regulations, but lacks C10’s distinctive definitional correspondence. C22 shares Treasury delegation and definitional/preservation machinery but not the child’s substantive architecture.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The term "agency" means each department, commission, authority, administration, board, or other independent establishment of the Government of the United States, including any wholly-owned instrumentality of the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: "Government agency" includes any executive department and any independent commission, board, office, agency, authority, or other establishment of the Executive Branch of the Government of the United States (including any such... wholly-owned corporation)
shared_material.explanation: The unusually detailed and similarly ordered enumeration of covered federal entities is concrete shared drafting language, adapted to the child’s statutory scope.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The head of each agency shall designate, or provide for the designation of the officers or employees whose duty... shall be to withhold taxes, file required returns, and direct the payment of such taxes
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each Government agency shall take all steps appropriate to effectuate this order, including the promulgation of necessary regulations
shared_material.explanation: Both use a government-wide framework in which each covered agency must implement the central policy through its own officers or regulations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Treasury authority to prescribe such rules and regulations not inconsistent herewith as may be necessary further to effectuate... this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to formulate and submit to the President for approval such proposed rules and regulations as may be necessary or desirable to implement and effectuate the aforesaid policies... Each Government agency shall... promulgat[e] necessary regulations which shall not be inconsistent with this order
shared_material.explanation: Both couple centralized regulatory authority with an express consistency limitation and agency-level implementation.
